# T4.6 (TASKS.md) -- graceful handover (DESIGN.md §2.6). A leader whose own
# stability score stays below HandoverThreshold for DegradeWindow
# consecutive heartbeat intervals proactively transfers leadership to its
# heir, reusing the existing MsgTransferLeader/MsgTimeoutNow path verbatim.
# Written first per the TDD convention, before maybeGracefulHandover landed
# in raft.go.
#
# Cooldown-prevents-ping-pong is verified precisely and deterministically in
# the unit test TestMaybeGracefulHandover_CooldownPreventsRetrigger (raft
# package) instead of here: reproducing an aborted/timed-out transfer in the
# interaction harness (to get the leader back so it could try to
# re-trigger) would need a second, independent mechanism (holding the heir
# back from catching up) that doesn't otherwise belong in this test, for a
# property the unit test already pins exactly.

log-level error
----
ok

# Cluster A: the happy path. id 1 leads, starts out healthy (mutable score),
# then degrades; id 2 is the heir (high, fixed score, comfortably above
# HandoverThreshold=64 + HysteresisMargin=20); id 3 is an ordinary follower.
add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true graceful-handover=true degrade-window=2 mutable-stability-score=200
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=255
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=100
----
ok

----
ok

# Heir leads next term (T4.6 accept criterion), reusing the existing
# transfer path -- MsgTimeoutNow made 2 campaign immediately, bypassing
# PreVote (campaignTransfer), so this is a single-round transfer of power.
raft-state
----
1: StateFollower (Voter) Term:2 Lead:2
2: StateLeader (Voter) Term:2 Lead:2
3: StateFollower (Voter) Term:2 Lead:2

# Cluster B: no eligible heir. GracefulHandover on, but HeirElection off, so
# no heir is ever selected (r.heir stays None) -- sustained degradation must
# never produce a transfer (T4.6 accept criterion).
add-nodes 1 voters=(4,5,6) index=2 graceful-handover=true degrade-window=1 mutable-stability-score=30

ok
